scope_note: Results cover the exact identities, counterexamples and finite ranges stated for each script. They do not certify general theorems beyond those scopes.

runs.scope: Exact finite identities and counterexamples for sections 4 through 6: two-atom Lp change of measure, resolvent sign, finite commutants, polynomial differential forms in dimension 3, small Lie algebras and root systems, quaternionic forms, Grassmann charts for n<=5, literal Dynkin BCH and differential of exp through degree 6, inverse series through degree 9, and bounded O(k) transitions. No general spectral, classification, integration or convergence theorem; arbitrary-degree normalization uses the separate J_k=k! argument.
Two exact rational squared inequalities enclose sqrt(17.5)/2^30 between 3.89e-9 and 3.90e-9 and below 0.004. This is the stated numerical bound, not a general mixing theorem.
25 intertwining counts for cubic rotation actions, adjacency matrices of three polyhedra, and eight Walsh vectors. No general representation classification.

Symbolic conjugation Jacobian, pushforward density and modular square-root factor for ax+b on a>1, with the exact witness a=4. Checks the local density convention, not a general kernel or character theorem.
Rodrigues polynomial degrees 0 through 32, evaluated in QQ; not harmonic decomposition or injectivity.
Both characters of C2 in S3: all six traces and all 36 products for each; general diagonal-block proof stated separately.

An exact rational 3-dimensional representation of Z^2 and the trivial module give Hom dimensions 2 and 1. Refutes unrestricted symmetry of intertwining dimensions; does not prove the completely reducible case.

All six elements and three cosets of S3/C2, with eight cutoffs in the rational standard module. Tests cutoff independence for an H-fixed vector and refutes the printed scalar stabilizer condition; no general distribution classification proof.
30 rational matrices of orders 2,4,6; exterior powers, Pfaffian determinant, and negative-density counterexample. No general Plancherel theorem.
320 exact polynomial commutators and 40 transition-function identities. No global analytic integrability or self-adjointness proof.
24 exact Haar-density identities for SU(2), weights 0 through 5 and four angles, with counterexamples to two wrong exponents and the full-measure claim. No general character theorem.
All Lie brackets of linear and symmetric quadratic operators for n=1,2 over QQ(t), and both Schrodinger/Bargmann signs; no analytic unitarity assertion.
Exact quaternion and F4 models; cyclic presentations m,n=1..12; decimal CRT k=1..8; real tensor-algebra and small Clifford models. Finite checks do not prove the general classifications.
484 exact pairs of projectors; scalar and finite-dimensional counterexamples, not general operator-domain or reconstruction theorems.

C2 with trivial inducing representation: a zero integrated vector has a nonzero literal kernel before null quotients. Checks the rank-one quotient and 25 rational sample vectors, not general positivity or analytic induction.
Exact symbolic local modular covariance on the SL2 big cell and the ax+b inversion Jacobian. Global kernel boundedness and the distributional averaging repair are separate arguments.

Nonzero Laplacian of log((1+x^2+y^2)^(-2)) refutes holomorphic flattening of the positive Fubini-Study model; 64 polynomial vector-field brackets check the half-density correction. No general integration-by-parts, self-adjointness or group-integrability theorem.
64 cocycles of (C2)^4 checked on all triples, with pairwise distinct commutator invariants; exact clock/shift matrices over QQ(zeta3).
Universal PBW identity for sigma(R^2), powers 1 through 8, highest weights 0 through 12, and the Duflo correction on R and R^2 computed from ad(X). No general classification proof.
All nonzero vectors and nonzero parameters over F2, F3, F4 and F5; the general case uses the stated rank argument.
Polynomial identities over QQ and two small exact evaluations; not the classification of representations.
All elementary skew matrices on all Clifford generators in dimensions 2 through 8; Pauli counterexample to a uniform orthogonal target. General commutator proof is separate.
Generic rational block-matrix character identities for k=1 through 4 and all signs, with a counterexample to the printed phase.

An explicit functional on the real upper triangular 4x4 Lie algebra has Kirillov rank 8, kernel dimension 2 and a generic block invariant excluding the proposed antidiagonal family. Refutes completeness of that family; does not classify other regular orbits.
Generic rational unit rotations, coadjoint pairing, two Fourier-kernel substitution identities and three refuted printed readings; no irreducibility or type-I classification proof.

All 49 brackets of the seven-dimensional matrix algebra and all 49 orbit-form pairings in the normalized Alt convention: J_2(B_Omega)=2*B_Omega is the ordinary form; rank and mixed-sign counterexample. No global orbit classification.
